name: Aelar Moonglimmer
who: Aelar Moonglimmer, a tall, gaunt older male elf with swept-back silver-grey hair, pointed ears and a lined, watchful face, in a dark charcoal cloak with its hood down over a dark blue quilted tunic, a belt of pouches, dark trousers and tall olive boots
stow: He holds nothing: the dagger stays sheathed at his belt, and both hands are empty and open. The cloak hangs straight down behind the shoulders and the sleeves hang from the arms alone, so nothing of the cloth bridges the gap between an arm and the body.
